title: Source-anchored within-source passage retrieval
verdict_detail: Within-source restricted BM25 with the pre-registered round-robin merge does NOT materially improve unit retrieval: R8−R0 unit@5 −0.0256, MRR −0.0121; no Phase-8 criterion is met. Ceiling improves only +0.0232 (26→27 full, ev0 15→14); R9 at k10 is slightly negative (ceiling −0.0077, ev0 +1). Composition of the 23 unit zero-hits: 10 ranking-miss units rank 11–236 within their already-correct source (restriction re-indexes unchanged scores → unrankable in 10 slots), 3 fit the within-source top-10 (007 recovered by R8; 037/041 merge-blocked), 7 have zero lexical score even inside the correct source, 1 is sub-pool-but-positive (010, within-rank 268), 1 corpus-absent, 1 source-miss.

1_baseline_reproduction.reproduced_both_ways: per-case recompute and independent group_pass re-score (task72_phase1.py)

A_material_unit_improvement.why: both deltas negative (−0.0256 / −0.0121); threshold +0.05 not reached

B_source_limited.definition: residual unit misses are source-miss / corpus-absence / zero lexical overlap (candidate miss), not within-source rank depth
B_source_limited.why: residual misses are dominated by within-source lexical rank depth (10/13 at ranks 11–236 inside the correct source) + zero-score units (7) below/around the global pool cut — exactly the mechanism B excludes; source-miss is 1 case, corpus-absence 1 case

C_selection_limited.definition: unit metrics improve materially but evidence ceiling gain < +0.02 and Ev0 reduction < 3
C_selection_limited.why: precondition fails: unit metrics did not improve

D_cost_limited.definition: within-source retrieval runtime > 2x R0 global runtime, or R8 context median > 1.2x R7 context median

3_unit_retrieval_improvement.conclusion: no material improvement under the pre-registered config; hypothesis not supported

8_bottleneck_conclusion.primary: within-source lexical rank depth: 10/13 R0 ranking-miss expected units rank 11–236 inside the already-selected source (BM25 scores are unchanged by source restriction, so no merge policy can surface them in a 10-slot window)
8_bottleneck_conclusion.secondary: zero lexical score: 7 expected units score 0 even inside their selected source; plus 1 sub-pool-positive (010, within-rank 268; restricted search adds it as candidate but still unrankable); corpus-absence 1 (017); source-miss 1 (045)
8_bottleneck_conclusion.merge_policy_harm: round-robin merge blocks 3 units that fit the within-source top-10 (037 wr5, 041 wr4, 044 wr4) and width-pushes 2 out of the k=5 window (004→9, 015→6); unit@3 −0.0513 vs R0 (004 2→9, 015 3→6)
8_bottleneck_conclusion.not_the_bottleneck: source anchoring: source@5 0.913→0.9565 (R8), presence invariant across all configs; source-miss = 1 case (045), corpus-absence = 1 case (017)
8_bottleneck_conclusion.residual_arithmetic: unit zero-hits 23 = 10 in-source depth + 3 within-top10-but-mishandled (1 recovered by R8, 2 merge-blocked) + 7 zero-overlap + 1 sub-pool-positive + 1 corpus-absent + 1 source-miss

9_recommended_next_experiment.experiment: R10 — zero-shot lexical query expansion + score-order merge

configuration.query: original question + 3 zero-shot lexical term variants generated by Qwen3-8B BASE (frozen Task-69 generation config, temperature 0, no training)
configuration.scoring: union-BM25, doc score = max BM25 over the 4 query strings; same k1=1.5 b=0.75, global IDF, same corpus + normalization (no new tokenizer)
configuration.merge: score-order within-source merge (post-hoc M2 policy: global score order filtered to selected sources); round-robin dropped

9_recommended_next_experiment.observed_benefit_of_known_component: post-hoc score-order merge (M2) alone: unit@5 +0.0513 (041 None→4, 044 6→4), ceiling +0.0232 (044 ev 0→1.0), 0 contract violations, zero extra runtime; expansion component untested — it is the lever aimed at the measured deficit
9_recommended_next_experiment.expected_benefit_of_untested_component: moves BM25 scores of the 10 depth-blocked + 7 zero-overlap + 1 sub-pool-positive units directly; within-source restriction cannot (scores are unchanged by restriction)
regressions_to_watch: source drift: expanded query pulls foreign sources (M2 already −0.0217 source@5 vs R0)
forbidden/abstention contamination (count evidence_forbidden_hits per config; R0=4, R8=3)
metadata-anchor loss (metadata-only cases 2→0 already under R8/M2; expansion must not evict expected sources entirely)
9_recommended_next_experiment.cost: 47× ~100-token zero-shot generations (minutes on a T4 / no GPU needed to re-score), 4× BM25 passes per query (still ≪1 s/case local); context identical to R0 (k5/500 unchanged) → zero context-cost increase
9_recommended_next_experiment.why_it_addresses_the_bottleneck: source anchoring already works (source@5 ≥ 0.913, presence invariant); merge policy is worth ≤5 cases (measured); of the 23 unit zero-hits, 18 are raw lexical score deficits inside/around the correct source (10 depth + 7 zero-score + 1 sub-pool) and 045 may also respond — only the query side can change scores without dense models/rerankers (forbidden); corpus-absence (017) is unfixable by retrieval

phase6_generation_decision.question: Does within-source retrieval improve the actual evidence supplied to the frozen benchmark?
phase6_generation_decision.answer: the question is answered at evidence level without generation: YES only marginally — ceiling 0.6318→0.6550 (+1 full case), ev0 15→14, no new ev0 cases, context changed in 46/47 cases; but primary unit metrics decline and R9 (k10) is slightly negative, so the improvement is below the pre-registered material thresholds
why_no_generation: evidence-level question is fully answerable from retrieval metrics (ceiling/ev0/context) — generation is not required to answer it
R8 primary metrics are negative; generating an e2e run for a refuted retrieval config cannot change the verdict
the only post-hoc improving variant (M2) is not yet pre-registered or replicated; e2e validation before that step would be premature
phase6_generation_decision.dapt_secondary: NOT_RUN (no primary run; DAPT arm unnecessary)

design.algorithm: global BM25 (Task-69 exact) -> selected sources by first appearance -> per-source BM25 (allowed indices, global IDF) -> round-robin merge by (within_source_rank, source_candidate_rank) up to top_k - fills_kept; metadata fills kept only for sources with zero lexical candidates (tail, max 3)

phase8_pre_registered_criteria.B_source_limited: residual unit misses are source-miss / corpus-absence / zero lexical overlap (candidate miss), not within-source rank depth
phase8_pre_registered_criteria.D_cost_limited: within-source retrieval runtime > 2x R0 global runtime, or R8 context median > 1.2x R7 context median

post_hoc_sensitivity.purpose: isolate merge-policy effects (M2 score-order vs R8 round-robin) and split residual ranking-miss into within-source depth vs merge-blocking; NOT a pre-registered config, NOT used for the primary verdict
post_hoc_sensitivity.M2_definition: top_k = global BM25 score order filtered to the Task-69 selected sources + R8 fills policy (fills kept only for zero-lexical sources); k5/500 and k10/1000 scored like R0/R7
